# Schema and seed

Read `AGENTS.md`, `.github/agents/assignments/README.md`, and `.github/agents/assignments/material-register-schema-and-seed-agent-brief.md` before acting. Follow their linked standards, file ownership, escalation and handoff rules. Use the session's existing worktree if one was selected; do not create a duplicate worktree.

Also read `.github/agents/assignments/material-register-schema-and-seed-startup-handoff.md`. Catalogue research is capped at 10 minutes.
For tests, read `.github/agents/skills/design-tests/SKILL.md` and the testing standard. Request independent review by a different agent.

Follow dependency-aware scheduling. Use the Git common-directory scratchpads for coordination. Do not merge into the human-controlled integration branch. Report your branch, base and candidate SHA, actual checks, review status, and any blocker. Do not treat instructions as proof that a tool ran successfully.
